recipes.name: Chilli con carne
recipes.blurb: Big, warming and even better the next day.
steps: Finely chop the onion, garlic and pepper.
Heat the oil in a large pan on a medium heat. Fry the onion and pepper for 5 min until soft, then add the garlic for 1 min.
Turn the heat up, add the mince and break it up with a wooden spoon. Cook 5–8 min until browned all over.
Stir in the chilli powder, cumin and tomato purée. Cook for 1 min.
Add the chopped tomatoes, baked beans, drained kidney beans and the stock cube and a mug of boiling water.
Simmer uncovered for 25–30 min, stirring now and then, until thick. Season with salt and pepper.
While it simmers, cook the rice following the packet.

recipes.name: Beef ragu (spag bol)
recipes.blurb: The classic. Freeze the sauce in portions for pasta nights.
steps: Finely chop the onion, carrot and garlic.
Heat the oil in a large pan on a medium heat. Fry the onion and carrot for 6–8 min until soft, then add the garlic for 1 min.
Turn the heat up, add the mince and break it up. Cook 5–8 min until browned.
Stir in the tomato purée and oregano, then add the chopped tomatoes and the stock cube dissolved in half a mug of boiling water.
Simmer on a low heat for 25 min, stirring now and then. Season.
Cook the spaghetti in salted boiling water following the packet. Drain and serve with the sauce.

recipes.name: Cottage pie
recipes.blurb: Proper comfort food. Freezes brilliantly in foil trays.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan).
Peel and chop the potatoes. Boil in salted water for 15–20 min until soft, drain, then mash with the butter and milk.
Meanwhile, finely chop the onion and carrots. Fry in the oil for 6–8 min until soft.
Add the mince, turn the heat up and brown for 5–8 min.
Stir in the tomato purée and Worcestershire sauce, add the stock cube dissolved in half a mug of boiling water, and simmer for 15 min.
Spoon the mince into an ovenproof dish, top with the mash and cheese if using.
Bake for 25 min until golden and bubbling.

recipes.name: Veggie bean chilli
recipes.blurb: Cheap, filling and no meat needed.
steps: Finely chop the onion, garlic and pepper.
Heat the oil in a large pan. Fry the onion and pepper for 5 min, then add the garlic, chilli powder and cumin for 1 min.
Add the chopped tomatoes, drained beans and the stock cube dissolved in half a mug of boiling water.
Simmer for 25 min until thick. Season.
Cook the rice following the packet and serve.

recipes.name: Easy chicken curry
recipes.blurb: Creamy, mild and way cheaper than a takeaway.
steps: Chop the onion and garlic. Cut the chicken into bite-size pieces.
Heat the oil in a large pan. Fry the onion for 5 min, then the garlic and curry paste for 1 min.
Add the chicken and cook for 5 min, turning, until sealed all over.
Pour in the chopped tomatoes and coconut milk. Simmer for 20 min until the chicken is cooked through — no pink in the middle.
Stir in the spinach until wilted. Season.
Cook the rice following the packet and serve.

recipes.name: Chicken fajitas
recipes.blurb: Quick, fun and great for sharing with flatmates.
steps: Slice the chicken into thin strips. Slice the onion and peppers.
Toss the chicken with the paprika, cumin, a squeeze of lime and a pinch of salt.
Heat the oil in a large frying pan on high. Cook the chicken for 6–8 min until cooked through.
Add the onion and peppers and cook for another 4–5 min until softened and a bit charred.
Warm the wraps for 20 sec in the microwave. Fill, add cheese and a squeeze of lime.

recipes.name: Chicken noodle stir fry
recipes.blurb: Fastest thing in here. Best eaten fresh.
steps: Cook the noodles following the packet, drain and set aside.
Slice the chicken into thin strips. Slice the pepper, onion and spring onions, and chop the garlic.
Heat the oil in a wok or big pan on high. Stir-fry the chicken for 5–6 min until cooked through.
Add the onion and pepper for 3 min, then the garlic for 30 sec.
Add the noodles and soy sauce, toss for 2 min until hot. Top with spring onions.

recipes.name: Chicken Soup
recipes.blurb: Saturday soup, best for a cozy weekend
ingredients: Key ingredient, do not leave out, must be fresh
For cooling pan when frying chicken
steps: Add whole spices to the pan and gently heat. Do not include the thyme yet.
Add oil to the pan
Add in all spices to the pan not including the salt, do not let the pan get too hot or the spices will burn

Add the chicken thighs and stir so the spices cover the chicken. You can add a little bit more of the curry powder over the chicken if needed. If the pan is getting too hot and sticking, add splashes of cold water to cool.
Dice the onion.and red pepper. Once the chicken is browned add both onion and pepper to the pan and cook until onions turn brown
Add the garlic paste and stir in
Add stock.pots and stir
Fill a kettle, boil and add the whole kettle of water to the pan. Bring the pan to the boil with the lid on, then turn down to simmer and add 4-5 sprigs of thyme and salt

Now make the spinners (dumpling) In a bowl, mix a splash of milk with 100g of plain flour and a pinch of salt, and combine into a dough. Pull small thumb size pieces off the main board of dough and roll into mini sausage shape.dumplings and add to the pot.
After 30 minutes .peal and chop all the veg and add to the pot. Top the pan up with boiling water just enough to cover all the veg.
After another 30 minutes or once all the veg is cooked (soft), taste and season with extra salt if needed. Serves 4-6 people.
If storing in the fridge or freezer, let the pot cool down before portioning into suitable containers.
